name: @clue-harness/kb
description: The ClueHarness knowledge base engine: entry model with source bindings, the five-state lifecycle (candidate/trusted/expired/discarded + M9-4's terminal superseded) with the orthogonal needs-review flag, the weighted signal ledger, the batched approval queue (incl. the advisory redline-review proposal), scan-based retrieval with redline-first scoring, and M9's document layer — immutable原文 snapshots (docs/), the derived chunk ledger (chunks/) rebuilt from the chunker stamp, checkDocs drift detection, and the human redline/split governance acts. Storage is central, one tier per workspace. Zero dsh dependencies.
